description.value: The Drive Canteen is a community-oriented snack bar and non-alcoholic bottle shop on Vancouver's bustling Commercial Drive, established in 2021. It offers locally made snacks, a curated selection of sophisticated non-alcoholic beverages, eclectic goods, and even a dedicated pet section. Situated on one of Vancouver's most bike-friendly corridors, it makes a distinctive pit stop for cyclists seeking a refreshment without alcohol.
